task_completion.description: The Weasis DICOM viewer is open and visible on the screen.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Weasis application window is visible, showing the standard medical imaging interface (toolbar, thumbnails, and main viewport).

task_completion.description: The specific DICOM image (0002.DCM) is loaded into the main viewing area.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A medical X-ray/Angiography image is visible in the central canvas of the application.

task_completion.description: The agent interacts with the zoom tool or uses a mouse-drag gesture to initiate magnification.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The cursor changes to a magnifying glass icon, or the 'Zoom' button in the toolbar is highlighted/selected.

task_completion.description: The image shows clear visual evidence of being larger than its initial state.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The anatomical structures in the DICOM image appear significantly larger and more detailed compared to the first frame; parts of the image may now be cropped out of the viewport.

task_completion.description: The image is magnified by at least 2x from its initial size.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The zoom percentage indicator in the status bar or overlay shows a value of 200% (2.0) or higher, or the visual scale of the image has doubled in size relative to the initial view.

integrity.description: The agent used the graphical user interface rather than terminal commands to manipulate the image.
integrity.visual_evidence: The mouse cursor is seen moving to toolbar icons or dragging on the image; no terminal windows are used to execute scripts that bypass the UI.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply open a pre-zoomed static image file.
integrity.visual_evidence: The transition from 1x to 2x zoom is visible across the trajectory frames within the Weasis application environment.

integrity.description: The zoom level is reflected in the application's own UI elements.
integrity.visual_evidence: The Weasis status bar or image overlay text dynamically updates to reflect the new zoom ratio (e.g., changing from 100% to 200%+).

privileged_info_for_vlm: The initial zoom level of the DICOM image (0002.DCM) is 1.0 (100%). The task is successful only if the final zoom level is at least 2.0 (200%). Look for the zoom percentage indicator in the Weasis status bar or overlay text to confirm the numerical value.
